notes: Starting cards are marked (S) in the post: Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Goo Nee Tay, Credits Will Do Fine, Boonta Eve Podrace, Podrace Prep and Anakin's Podracer, plus the Objective (which deploys Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts and Credits Will Do Fine); these count toward the 60.
Podrace Prep (S) is posted in the Interrupts section; the machine draft had dropped it and it was added back (total 60).
Posted 'THGG/We'll Need a New One' dested The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One.
Posted 'Padawan Obi' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Obi's Saber' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Premiere), the only Light Obi-Wan saber printed by then.
Posted 'EJP Lando' (Enhanced Jabba's Palace) dested Lando With Vibro-Ax, the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck premium Lando (adds a battle destiny at Tatooine sites).
Posted 'Qui-Gonn's Saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine); the post is dated the day before Reflections III, so not Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III).

Posted 'POAS' dested Projection Of A Skywalker; 'OOC/Trans. Term' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'YISYW' dested Your Insight Serves You Well (the Staging Areas combo is a Reflections III card); 'Ploo Koon' dested Plo Koon; 'R-3PO' dested R-3PO (Ar-Threepio).
Post date 30 October 2001 is the day before Reflections III; no Reflections III cards are listed.
